0022600028.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-3, 2-2 at home, 2 games back in the Southwest) host the Utah Jazz (1-7, 1-4 at home) after a loss, while Utah enters on a six-game losing streak. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Max Christie (hip), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Mavericks won the most recent meeting 138-120 in Dallas on January 17, 2026, with no games yet between them this season.
